channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Apache
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Apache, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch: Multiple High Severity Vulnerabilities in Apache Camel
item.description:
Apache Camel: CCB warning · fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for Apache Camel. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

High · Fix available

item.title: Find old versions: Apache Struts: Command Injection
item.description:
Apache Struts: RCE · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 2.3.20.3, 2.3.24.3, 2.3.28.1

First step: This flaw dates from 2016, but CISA only now lists it as exploited. Find any system that still runs an affected version of Apache Struts, and update or retire it.

Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

High · Fix available · CVE-2016-3081
